The '''electropole''' (not to be confused with the [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]]) was an electric melee weapon used by many cultures, including the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].

==Description==
[[File:JarJarCesta-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Jar Jar Binks wielding an electropole]]
The electropole was similar to the [[Force pike/Legends|Force pike]] and the [[Static pike/Legends|static pikes]] used by picadors on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. It could be used by either striking the enemy at close range, or by throwing it like a javelin. Some [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droids]] experienced hard wiring failure and beat Human workers with an electropole on Kadril.

Originating as a herding tool, electropoles were used by Gungan herders to lead their [[Shaak/Legends|Shaaks]] and guard them, and by Swokes Swokes to help domesticate the [[schinga shikou]]. Because of Gungan's familiarity with the tool, the mounted [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] riders of the Gungan militia used the weapon in battle, such as during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] against the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Its light weight allowed for it to be thrown, and because the electronic components were watertight, they could be used underwater as well as on the land.
